title: Sleepy flamingo
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='44' y='78' width='3' height='18' rx='1.5' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <rect x='54' y='80' width='3' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='22' ry='13' fill='#ff86bb'/>
  <!-- tail feathers -->
  <path d='M74 64 Q86 60 82 72 Q78 70 74 70 Z' fill='#ff2e88'/>
  <path d='M73 70 Q84 72 78 80 Q74 76 72 74 Z' fill='#e01e74'/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='64' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#ff2e88'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='63' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <!-- neck curved down, sleepy -->
  <path d='M32 62 Q18 56 20 40 Q22 26 34 24' fill='none' stroke='#ff5fa2' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M32 62 Q18 56 20 40 Q22 26 34 24' fill='none' stroke='#ff86bb' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='24' r='10' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='22' r='6' fill='#ff86bb'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eye -->
  <path d='M38 22 Q41 26 44 22' fill='none' stroke='#5a0e33' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- beak, angled down -->
  <path d='M46 25 Q56 28 54 36 Q48 36 45 30 Z' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <path d='M54 36 Q52 33 49 31 L50 29 Q55 31 54 36 Z' fill='#3a3a3a'/>
  <!-- beak tip dark but lit -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='34' r='2' fill='#6b4bb0'/>
  <!-- rosy cheek -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='27' r='2.5' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
</svg>
